meta.description: Standalone CLAP line for the current mgpusim-chiplet simulator
workflow: 1) baseline RR run with no plan to generate profile.json
2) planner consumes profile.json and emits placement-only explicit plan
3) final run uses the explicit plan while keeping simulator RR scheduling
meta.note: This config belongs to the independent CLAP branch only. It does not depend on the ILP planner / seed / freeze workflow. max_contiguous_group_pages is clamped to banks_per_chiplet so grouped decisions remain realizable as contiguous page groups in the current simulator allocator.
meta.selection_note: Use per-buffer page-group selection by default to better match CLAP's per-data-structure suitable page-size selection.
